name: UploadMediaInput
description: Represents the input needed for creating a pre-signed upload URL.

inputFields.name: alt
inputFields.description: The alternative text for the media item.

inputFields.name: database
inputFields.description: The database of the media item.

inputFields.name: includeExtensionInItemName
inputFields.description: The indicator to include the file extension with the item name.

inputFields.name: itemPath
inputFields.description: The relative path, under sitecore media library, of the media item.

inputFields.name: language
inputFields.description: The language of the media item.

inputFields.name: overwriteExisting
inputFields.description: The indicator to overwrite the media item.

inputFields.name: versioned
inputFields.description: The indicator to version the media item.
